summary: Final verification of unauthenticated root ('/') visit. Cleared cookies, navigated to '/', polled for toasts for 4 seconds. Result: user is silently redirected to '/login', NO 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard' toast appears, NO 'Sesi telah habis' toast appears, no console errors. The prior race condition (DashboardTab mounting briefly before redirect) has been resolved by the guard `if (loading || !currentUser)` at App.js:429 which prevents child Routes/DashboardTab from mounting until currentUser is set. All 3 verifications PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix confirmed at /app/frontend/src/App.js:429 — rendering the loading spinner when either loading is true OR currentUser is null successfully suppresses the transient DashboardTab mount that caused the dashboard-stats 401 toast on unauth root visits.
Optional hardening (carry-over): add a global axios response interceptor that swallows 401 toasts and redirects to /login for extra safety on any authenticated route hit without a session.
test_credentials: Not needed for this verification (unauthenticated flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard' regression from iteration_3 is now fully resolved. Unauth visit to '/' redirects silently to '/login' with zero error toasts. No further action required.
rca of the issue: Previously MainAppLayout set loading=false before navigate('/login'), causing child DashboardTab to mount and fire /dashboard/stats which 401'd and toasted an error. Fix: the render guard was tightened to `loading || !currentUser`, ensuring children never mount without an authenticated user; navigate then completes cleanly.
